text: The mahjong dojos of One Han City are suitable for people of all ages as they are warm in winter and cool in summer, making them people's preferred entertainment venue in this weather.

But I'm not like them because I simply like to play mahjong. I've also been to dojos that don't have air conditioning, and it isn't a big deal because you'll naturally cool down after losing enough games...
Opposite Player
{character:Opposite Player}Red.
I pause for a moment after looking at my hand. It really isn't that easy to win with Four Concealed Triplets after all.
{character:???}Kan now! You're a moron if you don't Kan when you can. Go against them.
After I hear that familiar voice, a hand reaches out from behind me and takes the Red in the opposite player's discarded tiles and three Reds in my hand, placing them in a corner of the table...
{character:???}Kan!
player
{character:player}Wait!
{character:player}What's the point of playing an Open Kan when it's only one Han?!
I turn my head angrily and see Kutsuji standing behind me. He is smiling smugly, like he is very satisfied with his masterpiece just now.
Kutsuji
{character:Kutsuji}I just helped you set up something big. You'll get lots of points if you win this game.
I look at the Dora indicator that was just flipped over. It's a Green.
It's good, but...
{character:player}You spoke so loudly. Now everyone knows my tiles are great. Who's going to deal into my hand now?!
{character:Kutsuji}You can win with a Tsumo. Is that supposed to be difficult?
{character:player}You make it sound so easy. You get me one then!

I wonder if it's too late to take back what I just said because Kutsuji really did manage to help me Tsumo and win in the next turn. Although I'm sitting comfortably in first place in this Hanchan with a pile of Dora, everyone is obviously unhappy with how Kutsuji helped me win.
I won't be able to keep playing now.
I apologize to everyone and drag the culprit out of the dojo.
{character:player}Don't you know that a true gentleman doesn't give advice when another person is playing?
{character:Kutsuji}I know that.
{character:player}Oh I get it. You're going to tell me it doesn't apply since you're not a gentleman anyway.
{character:Kutsuji}Is this the legendary skill of answering for other people and leaving them with nothing to say? I learn something new from you every single time.
{character:player}You flatter me.
{character:player}You don't come to me unless you want something from me. You're here about the next part of our transaction, right?
{character:Kutsuji}Can't I just see you to have some fun with you? You're so coldhearted.
As he speaks, Kutsuji takes a red helmet from his black motorcycle and hands it to me. I glance at the blue and black helmet hanging at the front of the motorcycle and decide...
{character:player}I want the blue and black one.
{character:Kutsuji}What's your reason?
{character:player}It fits my cool and suave temperament better.
{character:player}...
{character:Kutsuji}...
{character:Kutsuji}I've never met someone who wants to use a helmet someone else has worn before instead of a new one... Fine, you're the boss. We'll do whatever you want.

Kutsuji mutters as he takes the blue and black helmet from the front of the motorcycle and hands it to me. It's obvious that this almost new helmet has been in good care, and the logo on it draws attention to its expensive price.
{character:Kutsuji}Here you go. You better wear the helmet you requested properly.

I sit at the back of Kutsuji's motorcycle after I receive the blue and black helmet with satisfaction and wear it. I must say that you get what you pay for. There's a reason why this helmet is expensive.
{character:player}Red suits you quite well. It's a good match for your arrogant temperament.
{character:Kutsuji}Keep praising me. I love hearing it.
{character:player}...I'm done. Start up your motorcycle.

Kutsuji is driving a modified Tiger T-REX. Although I prefer its brother in the same series, Tyrannosaurus, which is a very expensive motorcycle that appeared on my CatChat homepage from time to time.

Thinking of this, I feel like thanking my good friend Nadeshiko. Thanks to her influence, I'm now familiar with most motorcycles on the market, even though the extent of my familiarity with them depends on Nadeshiko's preferences because what she likes will appear on my CatChat homepage more frequently.

This red helmet does look better than the other one. More importantly, this helmet is the one that Nadeshiko worked for most of the year to save enough money for the deposit - the one she showed me several times with a lot of anticipation - only to have her deposit returned to her by the seller when she finally saved enough money because it was sold out!
The helmet in my hand is obviously brand new, and it smells like it had just been opened. I can't help feeling that it's so nice to be rich.

After wearing the red helmet, I sit at the back of Kutsuji's motorcycle. Kutsuji is driving a modified Tiger T-REX. Although I prefer its brother in the same series, Tyrannosaurus, which is a very expensive motorcycle that appeared on my CatChat homepage from time to time.

Thinking of this, I feel like thanking my good friend Nadeshiko again. Thanks to her influence, I'm now familiar with most motorcycles on the market, even though the extent of my familiarity with them depends on her preferences because the information of motorcycles she likes will appear on my CatChat homepage more frequently.
However, this motorcycle is living up to its name right now.

I feel like I'm sitting on a tiger that is running and jumping around in the forest, and I feel really insecure without a safety belt! To not fly off, I hold onto Kutsuji's jacket as hard as I can. Moreover, even the slightest sound that seems like something is tearing makes me wary of whether his jacket is breaking!
How can someone who is riding a motorcycle through rows of high-rise buildings make it seem like they are riding a mountain bike in a hilly area?

During the bumpy ride, I begin to miss the sense of security I had in the back seat of Nadeshiko's motorcycle. I start thinking to myself that I swear this is the first and last time I get on a motorcycle Kutsuji is driving.
We still haven't arrived at our destination after a long ride, so I resist the dizziness caused by the powerful swaying and ask Kutsuji some questions.
{character:player}How much longer is this ride? Why aren't we there yet?!
Kutsuji stops next to the road, then he stops and turns to look at me.
{character:Kutsuji}Oh? I thought you were having a lot of fun behind me. I was thinking of taking you around for a few more laps.
{character:Kutsuji}What's wrong? Is this too much for you already?
He is trying to goad me? I can't tolerate that, especially when I think about how he'll keep roasting me with this in the future if I shrink back at this moment.
{character:player}I can take more. Let's do another lap then.

He looks at me with raised eyebrows. Without saying anything, he starts up the engine again and repeats the route we just took... My guess is that this route must have the worst road conditions in One Han City.
After one lap, Kutsuji stops his motorcycle at the same spot, then he turns and looks at me.
{character:Kutsuji}How does it feel? Do you like it?
{character:Kutsuji}But... Just tell me if you can't take it anymore, and I'll take you somewhere to have a rest.
He's provoking me. He's definitely provoking me. I can see the naked provocation in his eyes.
With my bad temper, if I can stomach this, then I'll feel too embarrassed to flip the table over the next time I finish in fourth place in 20 consecutive mahjong games!
So, I sit up straight in the back seat and reply to Kutsuji in a steady, unperturbed, calm, and confident voice.
Keep going. Don't stop.
{character:player}Keep going. Don't stop.
{character:Kutsuji}I'm impressed. In that case, let me take you somewhere. It looks like the city is too small for you already.

Without waiting for me to ask where we'll be going, Kutsuji steps on the accelerator and speeds onto the road. Strong gusts of wind howl past my ears, drowning out the surprised cries that escape from my throat.

The ride isn't bumpy this time, just very fast with very high wind speeds. The scenery and other moving cars both fade quickly into the distance behind us. I, a good citizen who abides by laws and cherishes life, decide to discourage this kind of speeding behavior.
{character:player}You've--exceeded--the--speed--limit!
{character:Kutsuji}The--wind's--too--strong! I can't hear you clearly!
{character:player}I said--you've--exceeded--the--speed--limit!
{character:Kutsuji}I told you already. The--wind's--too strong! I can't hear you clearly!
You can never stop a person who is determined to speed. If you don't drive according to the rules, your loved ones will end up in tears.
When we finally stop, my body feels like it has become numb after being buffeted by the strong wind for so long. The moment I take off my helmet, I even feel like I'm not used to the outside air.
Kutsuji looks at me smugly, then pats the handlebar of his motorcycle. Although he hasn't said anything, I tacitly understand that he is still provoking me.
{character:player}Someone as upright as me will definitely fight against the forces of evil until the end, so there's no way I'll back down here.
{character:Kutsuji}In that case, I'll make sure I satisfy your desires.

We tacitly stop talking as we both get ready for the "battle". Kutsuji steps on the accelerator again, causing the motorcycle to shoot forward, and the huge inertia makes me grab his jacket and fall backward. Sigh... I forgot to remind him not to speed.
But he suddenly starts slowing down after advancing a short distance and stops by the side of the road.
{character:player}What are you doing? Are you finally going to bow down to the forces of justice?
{character:Kutsuji}Tsk, I'm out of gas.
{character:player}Out of gas?
{character:Kutsuji}I drove out of town yesterday and forgot to refuel my beloved motorcycle after I got back.
{character:Kutsuji}The main thing is that I didn't expect you would love sitting on the back seat so much.
{character:player}So it's my fault now? Hah!
I look up at the unfamiliar and desolate surroundings. We're in the suburbs now.
{character:player}Since you ran out of gas at such an awkward timing, do you think we will be able to get back to the city today?
{character:Kutsuji}You don't need to panic. I know someone around here who can give us some gas.

I follow Kutsuji, who is pushing the motorcycle, and we bicker the whole way as we try to blame each other for the predicament we are in. After walking for about fifteen minutes and turning at the fork in the road, I see a familiar-looking driving school.
What a coincidence! This is the place Nadeshiko took me to before.

This is obviously Kutsuji's destination. Judging from how he greets everyone here familiarly after entering, he seems to come here often as he is quite familiar with everything about the driving school.

The person who refuels Kutsuji's motorcycle for him happens to be the driving instructor who greeted Nadeshiko and me last time. His eyes sweep back and forth between Kutsuji and me twice, then he laughs and starts teasing me.
Driving Instructor
{character:Driving Instructor}Why aren't you here with little Nadeshiko this time?
{character:player}I was forced to come here this time, really.
{character:Driving Instructor}Haha, now that you know all the top students of our school, you have no excuse for being a bad driver in the future.
{character:player}Ahaha...

The driving instructor seems to have some misunderstanding about what it means to be a good driver. Based on what I know about Kutsuji and Nadeshiko, the only difference between them is that one bravely faces the punishment of traffic laws, while the other keeps testing the boundaries of traffic laws.
After refueling, Kutsuji and I bid farewell to the people here and set off for the city. This time, Kutsuji is very disciplined and drives me back honestly without speeding or taking a strange route.
{character:player}Why are you so familiar with the people at the driving school?
{character:Kutsuji}Hmm?
{character:player}I thought everyone at Strix taught themselves how to ride a motorcycle.
{character:Kutsuji}Well, you're not wrong about us being self-taught.

{character:Kutsuji}But we're law-abiding people. We know that it's necessary to get a driver's license first before we can ride a motorcycle. Even Strix isn't capable of issuing people driving licenses.
{character:player}According to the movies, aren't information dealers all experts at making false documents?
{character:Kutsuji}It's illegal to use false documents.
{character:player}Geez! The fact that you're suddenly obeying the law makes me think that you have a flexible moral bottom line.
{character:Kutsuji}It's good to be flexible. Anyway, if you really have the need, Strix can make you a full set of false documents.
{character:player}...I don't think it's likely I'll ever need to use this kind of service.
{character:player}Do the people at the driving school know you're the leader of Strix?
{character:Kutsuji}Hmm... Do you think information dealers print a stack of business cards and give them out to everyone?
{character:player}Oh, you don't do that?
I think about it for a moment. Quite a few people around me know about Strix and how to get in touch with them, which made me think they have been marketing themselves well.
{character:player}...I don't have any more questions. You can drive quietly now, and please take me to the destination safely, thank you.
{character:Kutsuji}Hah!

After Kutsuji returns to the urban area, he takes me to a teahouse near Countless Springs. I'm quite familiar with the scenery in these parts now since I've been here twice recently. Kutsuji leads me into the teahouse from the back door and goes straight to a private room on the second floor.
{character:player}Why did you suddenly want to come here?
{character:Kutsuji}It's to show you a brilliant performance, of course.

I sit by the window and immediately understand what he is referring to when I look out the window. The window of this private room faces the street where the main entrance of the teahouse is located, and a grand geisha parade is taking place right now.

{character:Kutsuji}Every once in a while, Countless Springs selects an auspicious day for the most popular geisha to wear her exclusive costume. She will walk from the entrance of Countless Springs to the end of the street and then return to Countless Springs. This is called the geisha parade.

{character:Kutsuji}One reason it is held is to highlight the unparalleled beauty of Countless Springs's geisha. Another reason is that Countless Springs owns all the businesses here, and only the most popular geisha is qualified to manage Countless Springs and take over these businesses.
{character:Kutsuji}So this parade also symbolizes an inspection tour of their own businesses and is a demonstration of their sovereignty.
{character:Kutsuji}Kurone Toujou has been the manager of Countless Springs ever since she conquered everyone with her talent and beauty when she was still a young girl more than ten years ago.
{character:Kutsuji}She is also the geisha who is in charge of the geisha parade every time it is held now.

I watch the parade while leaning against the window and listening to Kutsuji's explanation. In the middle of the crowd is a splendidly-dressed woman, but I can't see her appearance clearly due to the distance and because she is wearing a veil that seems to be made of a beaded curtain. Kutsuji casually taps the window frame and gives me a reminder.
{character:Kutsuji}That's Kurone Toujou.

The same mistake shouldn't be made more than three times, and you shouldn't start playing mahjong from the North. My principle is to be as flexible as an inchworm. As I no longer want to experience an unhealthy recreational activity such as a high-speed drive through One Han City, I choose to back down for now.
Surprisingly, Kutsuji doesn't take the chance to tease me further. Instead, he smiles and taps the helmet in my hand.
{character:Kutsuji}Put it back on. I'll take you for a real drive now.
I dubiously sit back on the back seat of his motorcycle. This time, Kutsuji drives at an obviously slower speed, and the breeze blowing on my exposed skin feels cool and pleasant.
But I start to feel the motorcycle slowing down before long. Finally, we stop by the side of the road.
{character:player}What's wrong?
He falls silent for a few seconds before turning to look at me.
{character:Kutsuji}I'm out of gas.
After gloating at his misfortune for 30 seconds, I look around us and suddenly realize that we're in the suburbs and have no way to get back.

The person who refuels Kutsuji's motorcycle for him happens to be the driving instructor who greeted Nadeshiko and me last time. His eyes sweep back and forth between Kutsuji and me twice, then he laughs and starts teasing me.
After refueling, Kutsuji and I bid farewell to the people here and set off for the city.

{character:Kutsuji}Every once in a while, Countless Springs selects an auspicious day for the most popular geisha to wear her exclusive costume. She will walk from the entrance of Countless Springs to the end of the street and then return to Countless Springs. This is called the geisha parade.
{character:Kutsuji}She is also the geisha who is in charge of the geisha parade every time it is held now.
{character:player}Don't tell me you're trying to let me experience what it's like to go on a motorcycle ride that feels like a roller coaster ride.
{character:Kutsuji}That's a rude analogy. No roller coaster ride is as exciting as a ride on the back seat of my motorcycle.
{character:Kutsuji}To me, the physical sensation of a roller coaster is at best like watching "Autobots 6" in 4D. The seat will shake a few times, and I'll see some effects through the 3D glasses.
{character:Kutsuji}If you don't believe me, I can take you out for another two laps so you can really feel it.

The sensible side of me tells me there's no need to experience something like that. There are always things in life that we insist on meaninglessly even though they don't bring us substantial benefits.

For example, winning a dare if you throw a piece of chalk at the head of the class teacher, having everyone admit that you're the greatest among everyone present if you dare to lick an iron railing in winter, or winning people's respect if you dare to say: "I don't care about what you think because I only care about what I think" loudly to your boss at next week's regular meeting...
Someone who is mentally mature like me will never be provoked into doing something that brings no real benefits a second time.
{character:player}Thanks but no thanks.
{character:player}I think we should find a place to finish our transaction first.
{character:Kutsuji}Sigh, what a shame. In that case, sit tight while I take you somewhere.
{character:player}Where are we going?
{character:Kutsuji}You'll find out when we get there.

After that, we experienced the same familiar scenery from before, except this time it feels like we are experiencing it in reverse. The only difference is that one of the streets we passed by was now wet, as if it had just rained in this area.

As the road is slippery, Kutsuji drives steadily after that because he cares about his own life even if he doesn't care about mine. The breeze after the rain feels cool on my skin and even feels a little comfortable.

After so many twists and turns, I didn't expect our destination to be a teahouse diagonally opposite Countless Springs. I'm quite familiar with the scenery in these parts now since I've been here twice recently. Kutsuji leads me into the teahouse from the back door and goes straight to a private room on the second floor.
{character:Kutsuji}I've brought you here to show you a brilliant performance.
{character:Kutsuji}This is the best place to watch the performance. Whenever there's a performance, reserving this spot is as difficult as winning that auction last time.

I sit by the window and look out the window. The window of this private room faces the street where the main entrance of the teahouse is located, and it is densely packed with approximately as many people as the day of the auction for the cut flowers.
{character:Kutsuji}Have you heard of the geisha parade before?
{character:player}Yes.

{character:Kutsuji}Countless Springs also has a custom like that. Every once in a while, it selects an auspicious day for the most popular geisha to wear her exclusive costume. She will walk from the entrance of Countless Springs to the end of the street and then return to Countless Springs. This is called the geisha parade.
After he finishes talking, I see the doors of Countless Springs open amidst loud cheering.

Several men wearing the same outfit walk out holding wooden signs in their hands and stand on both sides of the road. On the wooden signs are the emblem of Countless Springs and some words, but the words are too small for me to read them clearly.

Immediately after that, six girls wearing exquisite costumes line up on both sides, holding flower baskets as they exit the door in two lines. As they walk, they grab flowers in their baskets and throw them to their side, and the flowers land on the ground in the path between them.

Accompanied by the sound of rhythmic drums and music, I see a foot wearing white socks and high clogs stick out from the door, drawing a half-moon arc before hiding behind the door again, like a playful goldfish wagging its tail in the air after jumping out of the water.
After this repeats several times, a splendidly-dressed woman exits the door and walks slowly along the flower-paved road, maintaining a goldfish-like pace.
Due to the distance and because she is wearing a veil that seems to be made of a beaded curtain, I can't see her appearance clearly. Kutsuji casually taps the window frame and gives me a reminder.
Although I can see that he is provoking me, Kutsuji's driving skills are too much for me.
{character:player}I have motion sickness.
{character:Kutsuji}Oh... what a shame.
{character:Kutsuji}In that case, let's go to our destination.
{character:Kutsuji}You'll find out when we get there.

A thundershower starts just as we turn around to drive back. I remember seeing a blue rainstorm warning in the morning, but I was in the dojo at that time and never thought it would be relevant to me.

The torrential rain starts suddenly, drenching me like a bucket of water over my head. However, the outrageous thing is that nothing happened to Kutsuji, who is right in front of me. There is only less than ten centimeters between us, but the rain curtain has separated us into two different worlds.

To avoid getting rained on as much as possible, I press my body toward him and try to get as much of my head out of the rain curtain as possible. I remember a monkey I saw at the zoo in the past and think I look like that monkey after it stumbled into a ditch and was about to drown... Blergh! It's insulting to think about myself in that way.
{character:Kutsuji}I have something to say.
{character:Kutsuji}Can you stay away from me? Don't lean against me, you've gotten my back all wet.
{character:player}Drive faster then. Can't you see the rain right behind us?!
{character:Kutsuji}Hey... This is an urban area. My license will be suspended if I speed here.
{character:player}It doesn't matter since it's not my license anyway.

The pouring rain follows us all the way until we pass through an underground tunnel and reach the other side. I look at my fully drenched self and at Kutsuji, who is only wet around the back area, then I squint my eyes.
{character:player}You must have done that on purpose.
{character:Kutsuji}I'm innocent. I'm sure you know that One Han City is famous for its unpredictable weather. I didn't expect this to happen at all.
{character:Kutsuji}All I can say is that you're really special after all. I won't be surprised no matter what miracle happens to you now.
Kutsuji comforts me while he drives. When we finally stop, I realize that we're at the entrance of Chaque Jour.
{character:Kutsuji}To make amends, you can pick any outfit you want, and I'll give it to you for free as an apology.

I clean my hands quickly after entering the store and then start looking through the clothes. I decide to forgive him after looking at the price tags. After all, there's no bad blood between good partners.

After I get dressed and follow Kutsuji to the destination he mentioned, I realize that it is a teahouse diagonally opposite Countless Springs. I'm quite familiar with the scenery in these parts now since I've been here twice recently. Kutsuji leads me into the teahouse from the back door and goes straight to a private room on the second floor.

I sit by the window and look out the window. The window of this private room faces the street where the main entrance of the teahouse is located, and it is densely packed with approximately as many people as the day of the auction for the cut flowers. However, the flow of people has been blocked off by cordons on both sides of the street, leaving the middle of the street vacant. Meanwhile, some staff wearing the uniform of Countless Springs are monitoring the situation closely.
Kutsuji casually spins the plate of snacks in front of him and seems lost in thought. After a while, he looks up at me and starts explaining the situation.
{character:player}Huh? Doesn't that mean today is that auspicious day?
{character:Kutsuji}You're so smart.
{character:Kutsuji}You deserve a reward for getting it right. Your reward will be this plate of a snack called "cardamom."

As he speaks, he decisively pushes the plate of snacks he has been spinning around for a while toward me. At the same time, the faint fragrance of durian wafts over, telling me exactly what this snack tastes like.
As expected of an information dealer. He even knows that I like durian. But come to think of it, they've investigated me thoroughly, and my love for durian isn't a secret at all.

I receive a "cardamom" from Kutsuji and take a bite. The unique sweetness of durian fills my mouth instantly. This snack is filled with chunks of durian flesh, which has an ice cream-like texture after chilling. One bite of this snack is enough to fill a person with satisfaction and happiness. It is a treasure in this world.

I am filled with satisfaction after eating two pieces in a row. When I look up and see Kutsuji deliberately keeping his distance from me, as well as the look of disbelief on his face, I suddenly realize something.
{character:player}You don't eat durian?
{character:Kutsuji}I don't eat it... I have no idea how anyone can like this type of thing.
{character:player}What? Durian is so tasty!
{character:Kutsuji}Tsk...
{character:Kutsuji}Ning tricked me into taking a bite when I was little... It tasted like a scallion pancake that had gone bad for a week.
{character:player}Who's "Ning"?
{character:Kutsuji}She's the person who raised me.
{character:player}Is she also a member of Strix?
{character:Kutsuji}Yes and no.
{character:player}Oh, you should try some now then. I think there might have been something wrong with the piece you ate back then.
{character:Kutsuji}That won't be necessary.
{character:Kutsuji}Oh and I'm not the only one who doesn't eat it. Nobody in Strix eats durian.
Suddenly, Kutsuji moves closer to me while pinching his nose and speaks in a low voice.
{character:Kutsuji}There's something you must remember.
{character:Kutsuji}It's a serious crime to eat durian inside Strix. Something terrible will happen.
{character:player}Is there some sort of punishment?
He smiles strangely. It is a smile that feels... very threatening.
{character:Kutsuji}You're welcome to find out.
{character:player}No... It's not like I'll get anything even if I do it.
After listening to Kutsuji's words, the "cardamom" on the plate is no longer appetizing to me, so I push the plate slightly further away from me.
{character:player}Forget it. Let's change the subject and talk about the next part of our transaction.
{character:Kutsuji}Speaking of our transaction, the parade is about to start. It won't be too late to tell you after we finish watching the parade.
I follow his gaze and look downstairs, only to realize that it had become quiet downstairs at some point. Everyone stops making noise and looks at the entrance of Countless Springs expectantly.
When the time on my phone reaches the hour on the dot, the doors of Countless Springs opens amidst a burst of loud cheering.

Accompanied by the sound of rhythmic drums and music, I see a foot wearing white socks and high clogs stick out from the door, drawing a half-moon arc before hiding behind the door again, like a playful goldfish wagging its tail in the air after jumping out of the water.
I push the plate back to Kutsuji expressionlessly. I won't eat it. I would starve to death today or jump off from the second floor before I take a single bite.

To my surprise, Kutsuji pauses for a moment before pushing it back to me. A piece of the snack splits off and falls on the plate as we keep pushing it back and forth... making the smell of durian even more potent.
{character:Kutsuji}It's not good to waste food.
{character:player}Then you shouldn't waste any.
When I push the plate back to him again, I notice that he is pushing the edge of the plate firmly with his fingers while holding his chin with his other hand and pretending to look away.
{character:player}Is it possible that you... don't eat durian?
{character:Kutsuji}I don't eat it.
{character:player}Why did you order it then if you don't eat it?
{character:Kutsuji}Who would have known that this traditional teahouse would follow the trend and also start making durian snacks... They even gave it a name that has nothing to do with durian.
{character:player}Oh, I didn't expect there to be something an information dealer doesn't know.

Kutsuji's expression gradually becomes stiff after hearing my words. It's obvious that even he didn't realize he would make such a mistake. However, he is a leader who has been through a lot, so it doesn't take him long to become his usual carefree self again.
{character:Kutsuji}It doesn't matter. It's not too late to collect this piece of information today.
{character:Kutsuji}In view of your contribution, I'll mark down first-class merit for you.
{character:player}I'm not a member of Strix. I don't need this first-class merit...
{character:player}But I won't say no if you insist on giving it to me. It'll be even better if I can redeem it for something more practical.
{character:Kutsuji}Something practical... Then I'll make an exception and allow you to waste food.
After that, Kutsuji turns and calls a waiter to remove this plate of snacks and replace it with a different-flavored snack.
{character:player}That's it? Aren't you afraid I'll tell others that you don't eat durian?
{character:Kutsuji}Haha, you don't need to threaten me. You can't move me with force or persuasion, and I only engage in profitable transactions.
{character:player}Oh, that's right. Speaking of which, don't you think it's time we got on with the rest of the transaction?
{character:Kutsuji}There's no rush. The parade is about to start. It won't be too late to take our time chatting after we finish watching the parade.
Kutsuji taps the window frame rhythmically along with the music below and seems immersed in the performance. When Kurone Toujou walks directly below us, he suddenly turns his head to look at me.
